title: Samhita Tree of Life Natural Stone Mortar & Pestle Mortar Diameter- 3.75"x 2.75" Pestle-5" x 1.5"
description:
About this item
Natural Stone Mortar and Pestle with Tree of Life Symbol Set for Kitchen Decoration and Fully Handmade Species Grinder
The mortar bowl and pestle work together to grind ingredients quickly to help speed up food preparation with minimum effort.
easy to use kitchen tool that creates dishes like guacamole, pesto, seasonings, grinds and crushes spices, herbs, salt, coffee beans and even pills.
Practical kitchen tools, exquisite workmanship, convenient cleaning and long service life.

reviews_1s: We use a mortar & pestle to grind up our Saffron & other herbs. After 3 months of use (twice a week), the top edges of this mortar began to chip off. Unless you want to add bits of whatever substance this mortar is made of to your meal, you may want to view other options.I noticed black wearing off when rubbed with olive oil, then what looked like overspray near the top inside of the mortar. Using brake cleaner on the pestle, it was clearly painted. I like paint, but not in my food. Into the trash.I love the look of it but mine never came.Pestle is cracked and I am not wasting my time and money to send it back.After opening the bubble wrap I noticed debris in the bottom and cracks in mortar inside before I opened the plastic wrap. When I opened it to see how bad the cracks were it fell apart in my hand.
